name: @axel-saas/openclaw-bridge-plugin
description: OpenClaw plugin that exposes Axel's gateway-contract REST surface (POST /api/chat, GET /api/health, POST /api/reload, GET /api/usage). Translates between the gateway-contract shape (specs/gateway-contract/design.md) and OpenClaw's first-party /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Loaded into the per-user OpenClaw container via `openclaw plugins install --link` at image build time.
